name: Auto Fast XP
summary: Automatically throws XP bottles rapidly when you hold right-click. Perfect for quickly gaining XP!
description: # Auto Fast XP Gain XP levels lightning fast! This mod automatically throws XP bottles rapidly when you hold right-click, making leveling up quick and effortless. ![a](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7017f55f603461ba9f235992559134654c3e1a15.png) ![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f7956d42223dc4e7f0f0ac5ac19089beb871178.png) ## Features - ✅ **Rapid Throwing** - Throws up to 20 XP bottles per second (default) - ✅ **Hold to Throw** - Just hold right-click, no need to spam click - ✅ **Both Hands** - Works with main hand and offhand - ✅ **Creative Mode** - Doesn't consume bottles in creative - ✅ **Lightweight** - Minimal performance impact ## How It Works Hold XP bottles in your hand (main or offhand). Hold down right-click. Watch as bottles are thrown rapidly! Release right-click to stop. ## Use Cases - **Quick Leveling** - Gain levels fast for enchanting - **XP Storage** - Quickly convert bottled XP back to levels - **Enchanting Prep** - Get to level 30 in seconds - **PVP** - Save time when using XP bottles
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
